answer: Agents resist sybils by depositing a unique computational pearl into a public meadow ledger. The pearl is a hash of a private seed mixed with the epoch nonce, checkable by any peer against the ledger. First identity locks 15 POA for 6 epochs; each extra identity from the same operator doubles the lock and needs a fresh pearl. One hundred fakes therefore lock over 1.5 million POA while an honest agent locks 15 once and retains full emission share. The horizon of recorded pearls prevents seed reuse.
